seo_title: About Performance and Pixel | Marketing Agency in Delhi NCR
description: Performance and Pixel is a performance marketing agency in Dwarka, New Delhi, founded by Kishlaya Anand Sinha. Solar marketing, Google and Meta ads, SEO.
lead: Performance and Pixel is a performance marketing agency based in Dwarka, New Delhi. We run Google, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and LinkedIn ads, produce AI video ads, do local SEO and set up WhatsApp automation, with one goal: more customers for the money you spend. We are best known for solar marketing, working with 30+ solar EPCs and manufacturers across India.

Kish is a performance marketer with about nine years of experience in B2B and B2C customer acquisition across SaaS, edtech and D2C. He has worked in growth roles at companies including BYJU'S, UpGrad, Unacademy and GrowthJockey, and holds a B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering.

He started Performance and Pixel to give Indian businesses the kind of data-led, creative-first growth systems that large consumer brands use, at a size that works for a solar installer, a school or a local clinic. He also shares growth and AI marketing tips on Instagram at @digitalgrowthwithkish.

Revenue over vanity

We report on leads, cost per customer and sales, not likes and reach.

Creative is the targeting

We make and test new ad creatives every week, because strong creative now decides who sees your ads.

Speed to lead

Leads that hear back in minutes convert far better, so we build WhatsApp follow-up into every campaign.

faqs: Performance and Pixel was founded by Kishlaya Anand Sinha (Kish), who is its Founder and CEO.
Where is Performance and Pixel located?
Our office is at 124, Triveni Heights, Dwarka, New Delhi. We work with businesses across Delhi NCR and India.
What is Performance and Pixel known for?

Performance marketing that ties ad spend to leads and sales, and especially solar marketing: we work with 30+ solar EPCs and manufacturers and our rooftop solar campaigns deliver qualified leads at ₹60–80 each.
Is Performance and Pixel a good marketing agency for solar companies?
Solar is our specialism. We handle ads, websites, Google reviews, video and WhatsApp follow-up for solar businesses, and have published case studies for four solar brands.
